topic: The Mole Concept and Mass Conversions
key_concepts: Formula mass is the sum of atomic masses in an empirical formula and is used for ionic com
Molecular mass is the sum of atomic masses in a molecular formula and is used for covalent
Formula mass is expressed in amu while molecular mass is expressed in g/mol
Molecular mass is calculated by multiplying each element's atomic mass by its number of at
Mefenamic acid C13H18O2 has a molecular mass of 206.31 amu
Limewater Ca(OH)2 has a formula mass of 74.10 amu
A mole is the amount of substance containing the same number of particles as 12 grams of c
Avogadro's number is 6.02 x 10^23 particles per mole
One mole of any substance contains 6.02 x 10^23 atoms, molecules, or formula units
Number of moles equals mass in grams divided by molar mass
Mass equals number of moles multiplied by molar mass
The mole concept relates mass, number of moles, and number of particles in stoichiometry
